description: My special made Resource Pack used in my Streams on Twitch/YouTube/Kick
body:
# N1ghtTheF0x's VTuber Resource Pack
This is just my version of a Dark Mode Resource Pack + some other small _personal_ changes...

![Main Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/bXUnZ37F/images/54a5a637a8478b5fcaeef837c61c4aed4a868fa0.png)

## Content

- Dark Mode interfaces _(with some text being actually visible)_
  - Blocks with GUI _(Crafting Table, Chests, etc.)_
  - Main Menu
  - Ping _(The green bar in Multiplayer when you press TAB)_
  - HUD _(Hotbar, Health, Armor, Exp Bar)_
- Custom **Totem Of Undying** _(do I need to explain this?)_
- `Java Edition` is now `N1ghtTheF0x Edition`
- Custom splash text _(mostly socials but contains some insider memes too)_
- _(currently)_ no panorama
